description: Exact runtime environments for the EmberSEC comparative evaluation

host.note: thermally noisy host; short interleaved runs only

ember-current.build: cargo build --release (default profile; panic=unwind; no debug asserts)

ember-baseline.build: cargo build --release (default profile; panic=unwind; no debug asserts)
ember-baseline.note: parent of the first EmberSEC commit 2eacfda; already contains the pre-EmberSEC fail-closed loader checks (9e434df)

llama-cpp.build: Release, GGML_NATIVE=OFF, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF; reference/llama_loader CMake harness (llama_model_load_from_file, load + free, no generation)
llama-cpp.note: FINAL matrix target: pristine b7999 loader API (load + free, no generation). S1 submitted upstream as PR #26946; S2/S3 were already fixed upstream and S5 is mitigated. llama-cli-based b5999 results remain in results/llama-cpp-cli-b5999.json for the record.

candle.note: Parser-level only (gguf_file::Content::read): header+metadata+tensor infos, no tensor data, no model construction. Semantic/model cases are expected to parse; NOT_COMPARABLE at the model level.
